title: Medication Synchronization Program Implementation
implementation_guidance: Implement a structured medication synchronization program where pharmacy technicians coordinate the refill schedule for all of a patient's chronic medications to be filled on the same day each month. The program should include: 1) Identifying eligible patients through prescription refill data analysis; 2) Conducting initial patient outreach to explain the program benefits; 3) Performing a comprehensive medication inventory and reconciliation; 4) Calculating appropriate short fills to align medication schedules; 5) Setting up a consistent monthly pickup or delivery date; and 6) Establishing a proactive monthly contact protocol to address any medication changes or issues before the scheduled fill date. Pharmacy technicians should document all patient interactions and maintain a dedicated calendar system for tracking synchronized patients.
expected_outcomes: Improved medication adherence rates, reduced gaps in therapy, increased patient satisfaction with pharmacy services, decreased pharmacy workflow bottlenecks, and improved chronic disease management outcomes.
target_population: Patients taking multiple chronic medications, particularly older adults and those with complex medication regimens
citation: Kadia NK, Schroeder MN. Community Pharmacy-Based Adherence Programs and the Role of Pharmacy Technicians: A Review. J Pharm Technol. 2015;31(2):51-57. doi:10.1177/8755122515572809
